info.title: bmo-agency
info.description: The agency's agents, their sessions, turns and runs, the executions on the agent host, the co-worker pool and places, providers, models, tiers and roads, accounts and rest, supervisors and workers, worker assignments, and the jobs it runs. A job is an item run on a worker for the harness that holds the item: the harness asks for a worker with POST /assignments, then hands the item's content and its lease over with POST /jobs. The run's progress, questions and outcome are its own events and fields, which the harness reads and carries into the job service, where it reports and closes the item; words appended to the item reach the run as the harness sends them into the job's session. As a job ends, the agency gives its lease back to the job service and queues its report in the room through the receiver's instruction route. Everything it remembers or runs on is an upstream it reaches through what that upstream publishes. It serves only its own nouns: a run with a fixed prompt is an ordinary session started with POST /sessions and the run's prompt document, and that session calls the upstreams it needs through their own MCP servers; no route or tool of the agency forwards to them. It calls no downstream; gate and receiver register at its hook points. It stays one service.

x-harness.entry: A harness holding an item asks for a worker with agency_assign_worker, hands the item and its lease over with agency_run_job, and reads the job's progress and outcome from the job's events and fields.

x-tools.name: review_job
x-tools.description: Examine a job's report under review, the one a job-review instruction names, on the check due now: ask puts your question to the worker in the job's own session and its answer comes back to you; reject sends the work back with why and what is to be done, to the stage under way or, naming stage, to an earlier stage whose work the report shows falls short, whose step is handed over again with the stages after it following; pass passes the check; escalate puts the work to the owner, refused until the work was sent back as often as the review's ceiling. x-tools.name: agent_fallback_add
x-tools.description: Add one fallback road to an agent: a provider and model, with its effort, thinking, answerTokens and advisor where given, at a position counted from 0, or last. A fallback is asked only where the road before it cannot answer for a clear reason read before anything goes out: the provider off, no credential, a spent balance, no login open, or a block for a refused access or a limit; never for an error a turn met. A job that moves onto one goes on there with its handoff. The road is judged as the agent's own is, and one it holds already is refused.

x-tools.name: agent_fallback_remove

x-tools.name: agent_fallback_move
